topic: Abrupt process death, V15 expired takeover, V16 request-ledger reconciliation, and producer-bound V17 terminal recovery
hypothesis: After a proven V15 EXPIRED_TAKEOVER, a dead interactive V16 execution may reconcile its still-ADMITTED request rows to FAILED while preserving request keys; verified effect outcome truth must remain governed independently by V14/V17 so the old effect can recover to DONE_VALID without duplicate execution.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Marking the request FAILED could conflate response-path failure with effect failure or weaken idempotency; therefore the candidate must preserve the exact request key, keep the old execution identity, produce REPLAY/FAILED on exact retry, and demonstrate exactly one effect attempt while V17 retains verified outcome truth.

fresh_primary_guidance.source: AWS Builders' Library - Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
fresh_primary_guidance.interpretation: A client may not know whether a mutating request succeeded when the response is lost; durable idempotency identifiers and reconciliation are required to avoid duplicate side effects.

fresh_primary_guidance.source: AWS Well-Architected - REL04-BP04 Make mutating operations idempotent
fresh_primary_guidance.interpretation: Retries of mutating operations must preserve idempotency semantics rather than blindly re-execute work.

diagnostic_process_crash_target_run.diagnosis: V17 terminal support is durable across abrupt process death, but V16 leaves the old exact request bound to a dead execution as ADMITTED.

authority_conditions: current V15 presence is BUSY at the supplied recovery epoch and exact recovery session/client
the same recovery epoch has a durable EXPIRED_TAKEOVER event
the takeover event hashes match the recovery holder
V16 still references a strictly older execution epoch
candidate_repair.mutation: Only still-ADMITTED request rows belonging to the stale execution/epoch become FAILED; request-key rows are retained; stale execution task state becomes FAILED; existing TASK_STATE_CHANGED events are appended.
candidate_repair.effect_truth_semantics: FAILED means the interactive owner execution/response path died; verified effect/provider outcome truth is not changed and remains governed by V14/V17.
candidate_repair.transaction_boundary: Reconciliation and subsequent normal V16 recovery bind are separate fail-closed transactions; a crash between them leaves no matching new V16 active execution able to authorize normal work.

first_repair_run.repair_to_test_only: Measure the canonical V14 ATTEMPT_STARTED lifecycle event instead of nonexistent effect_attempts table.

fusion.idempotency_invariant: Exact request key remains durable; retry is REPLAY/FAILED and cannot create a second effect attempt.
fusion.effect_truth_invariant: Execution/response-path FAILED does not override verified V14/V17 effect outcome truth.
known_limits: authority-negative controls without EXPIRED_TAKEOVER still need explicit target regression
no semantically equivalent response-body replay after crash
host power loss, kernel panic, filesystem-loss, and remote-provider reconciliation remain unmeasured
production non-bypass self.root routing remains separate

next_frontier: Add ordinary authority-negative controls proving no reconciliation can occur without a matching EXPIRED_TAKEOVER and exact recovery-holder binding.
Design response-replay semantics that expose verified prior outcome without re-running the side effect.
Bind V2 + V16 crash reconciliation + producer-bound V17 into the production non-bypass self.root route and re-run lifecycle crash/replay acceptance.
